content.text: {"name":"Hours momentum times separation-flow reversal","hypothesis":"Groups with rising hours (V01 3-month change rank) and falling flow V03 (negative 3-month change rank) have higher next-month relative returns; the interaction of the two cross-sectional ranks positively predicts, with a positive IC and HAC t above 1.","falsified_if":"Development mean IC is zero or negative, or HAC t-stat is below 1.","expression":"mult(csrank(chg(V01,3)),csrank(chg(V03,3)))"}
